description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Ring' functionality within the Orleans distributed system framework. It includes tests for basic ring operations, failure handling, joins, and mixed scenarios, utilizing the Xunit testing framework. The file also defines some internal classes like 'FakeSiloStatusOracle' and 'RangeBreakable' to support testing.

classes.name: RingTests_Standalone
classes.description: Contains multiple test methods validating the behavior of the consistent ring implementation in various scenarios such as failures, joins, and mixed operations.

classes.name: FakeSiloStatusOracle
classes.description: A mock implementation of ISiloStatusOracle for testing purposes, simulating silo statuses.

classes.name: RangeBreakable
classes.description: Utility class to manage ranges and verify coverage during testing.

methods.name: RingStandalone_Failures
methods.description: Test handling of node failures at various positions.

methods.name: RingStandalone_Mixed
methods.description: Test combined failure and join scenarios.

methods.name: TestChurn
methods.description: Simulate churn with failures and joins, then verify the ring.

methods.name: CreateServers
methods.description: Create a specified number of server instances with unique addresses.

methods.name: Combine
methods.description: Combine two sets of servers, updating each with references to the other.

methods.name: RemoveServers
methods.description: Remove specified servers and update the ring accordingly.

methods.name: VerifyRing
methods.description: Verify complete coverage and absence of overlaps in the ring.

methods.name: CompareSiloAddressesByHash
methods.description: Compare two silo addresses based on their consistent hash codes.
